# Risk & Compliance Quarterly Review and 2026 Strategy

This document details key action items for the Risk & Compliance department.

## Quarterly Reviews

*   Review internal controls on a quarterly basis.
*   Optimize Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection processes quarterly.

## 2026 Strategy Initiatives

*   Review legal risks pertinent to the 2026 strategy.
*   Optimize for regulatory changes impacting the 2026 strategy.
